scope: Quest tracking from the journal; minimal focused checks as requested.

targeted_tests.method: Production quest-tracking functions executed in Node VM with lightweight DOM and storage hooks
coverage: Manual selection replaces Atlas navigation, closes the journal and persists separately for each character.
Another quest becoming ready does not replace the selected quest.
The goal advances through unfinished objectives and then to the reward NPC, preserving coordinate and floor fallbacks.
Claiming the selected quest reward ends its tracking.
Explicitly disabled tracking remains off; locked and claimed quests cannot be selected.

source_review: Tracking controls appear below quest titles and before descriptions for available, active and ready quests.
Journal refresh signatures include selection, Atlas navigation and player floor.
The tracker opens the journal and scrolls the selected quest into view.
Enter and Space on tracking buttons bypass global chat and attack shortcuts.
Existing cross-floor directions remain unchanged; no new staircase pathfinding is added.
deployment: Local source and packages only; no push or live deployment.
